windowsFull.note: Initial full batch retained, not reported as green. A completed recovery file required termination after a cleanup failure left listeners open; its final full-file follow-up exits naturally. The slow serial transfer file was interrupted, all 29 original cases were rerun in four groups, and the sole failed locking fixture was then corrected and independently reverified.

linuxClock.note: The final run observed three reversals before the service was stopped again after a WSL restart; no new reversal was observed after the recorded treatment checkpoint. Original active/enabled service state was restored.

cleanup.notes: Only completed task-owned Linux and Windows verification directories were removed after process auditing. Raw evidence remains in the ignored workspace directory.
